topics.topic: Exact manifest checks and capability scope of check_installed_instances at startup without operation or proposed-port context
questions: Exactly which manifest checks must check_installed_instances perform at startup when it has no operation name or proposed ports?
Which exact A08 rule 5 checks run at startup, and over which capability entries, when this step receives no operation name or proposed ports needed by several of those checks?

Which exact A08 rule 5 checks are applied at startup when no operation or proposed ports are named, given that rule 5 also contains operation-presence, effect-class, route, idempotency-key, proposal-port and request-shape checks?

quotes: read_service_record: [VALIDATION_ERROR] Raises RefusedError naming the first failing check of the record itself, in this order: the record is absent at that revision, is not valid JSON, lacks service or capabilities, its service field differs from service_id, two capabilities share a name.

check_installed_instances: [VALIDATION_ERROR] Takes the services the installation holds a credential for, in service_id order by Unicode code point, and for each raises RefusedError naming that service at the first failure: first the credential header name equals a name in the imported KERNEL_SET_HEADER_NAMES constant compared without regard to case, host included, checked without reading the manifest; then, only when the installation selects an instance for the service, its record read by read_service_record fails any check, or the selected instance named in the record has a required header whose name equals the credential header name compared without regard to case.

check_installed_instances: [BEHAVIOR] A service with no selected instance, or whose record lists no instance of the selected name, fails nothing here; the check reads only the given installation and the manifest, never the store, and returns None when every service passes.
judgement.why: State 6 notes limit startup validation to read_service_record’s five record-level checks and the specified credential-header collision checks, excluding operation- and proposal-specific validation.

topics.topic: Behavior of grant_standing_approval when the target is a function node
questions: What happens when the named node is a function node and therefore has no effect class or operation binding?

topics.topic: Classification and outcomes of unsuccessful store capability results
questions: Which unsuccessful store results are expected domain refusals with their stated outcomes, and which are internal errors that stop the kernel?

topics.topic: Distinguishing instance_not_selected from instance_address_missing before sending
questions: How can `service_invoker` distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing` when `ManifestOperation` represents both situations with absent instance facts and the invoker may not read the selected-instance configuration?

topics.topic: Source of configured credential header names for startup collision checks
questions: How does `bindings.check_installed_instances` obtain each configured credential header name when neither named installation capability supplies it and no other public installation capability exposes it?
